column12: METHOD FOR MAKING A CURCUMINOID-CONTAINING DRUG DELIVERY COMPOSITION
column13: Silica nanocarriers hybridized with superparamagnetic iron oxide nanoparticles (“SPIONs”) and curcumin through equilibrium or enforced adsorption technique. Methods for dual delivery of SPIONs and curcumin to a target for diagnosis or therapy, for example, for SPION-based magnetic resonance imaging or for targeted delivery of curcumin to a cell or tissue. The nanocombination is functionalized with chitosan, polyacrylic acid, PLGA or another agent to increase its biocompatibility in vivo.

column12: UNIAXIALLY-ALIGNED NANOFIBER SCAFFOLDS AND METHODS FOR PRODUCING AND USING SAME
column13: Oral cavity wound healing occurs in an environment that sustains ongoing physical trauma and is rich in bacteria. Patients undergoing cleft palate repair have a high degree of wound healing complications, such as oronasal fistula (ONF) formation. Following hard palate injury, ONF was created that demonstrated little change in pro-regenerative monocytes LY6Clo monocytes; however, there were increased M2 macrophages observed. Delivery of FTY720 nanofiber scaffolds following hard palate injury prevented ONF formation, allowed complete wound healing and was associated with increased LY6Clo monocytes and pro-regenerative M2 macrophages. Evaluation of interleukin gene expression revealed reduction in pro-inflammatory IL1 and IL6 and increased expression of pro-regenerative IL10 with FTY720 nanofiber delivery. The ability of FTY720 scaffolds to increase LY6Clo monocytes, increase M2 macrophages and alter the interleukin expression during hard palate mucosal healing demonstrates the ability of a FTY720-based autotherapy to improve oral cavity wound healing.

column12: METHOD FOR PREPARING MICROPARTICLES CONTAINING MOXIDECTIN AND SUSTAINED RELEASE INJECTABLE COMPOSITION COMPRISING MICROPARTICLES PREPARED BY SAME PREPARATION METHOD
column13: Embodiments relate to microparticles containing moxidectin and a method for preparing same. Unlike conventional drugs for preventing heartworm disease, which have a short half-life and require daily or monthly administration, when the microparticles containing moxidectin are administered, moxidectin is continuously released for 3 months or longer, and thus, a heartworm disease preventive effect can be maintained. In addition, by preparing microparticles having a constant average particle diameter and a narrow diameter distribution width, even when the microparticles are administered, the initial over-release of moxidectin is prevented, and the release of the drug is controlled so that a concentration of moxidectin effective for three months or longer can be kept constant, and when the microparticles are applied as an injection, foreign body sensation and pain can be reduced.

column12: INHALATION FORMULATION OF AMOXICILLIN CLAVULANATE
column13: This invention provides a novel nebulization suspension comprising amoxicillin and clavulanate for the effective treatment of pneumonia. The formulation is specifically designed for pulmonary delivery, offering several advantages over traditional oral antibiotics. Key features include mucoadhesive properties that enhance drug retention 5 in the lungs, sustained release characteristics for prolonged therapeutic action, and potential biofilm disruption to combat antibiotic resistance. This localized delivery approach aims to minimize systemic side effects, improve treatment efficacy, and address the growing challenge of antibiotic resistance in pneumonia.

column12: Pregabalin sustained-release type dissolving microneedle patch based on PLGA microspheres as well as preparation method and application of pregabalin sustained-release type dissolving microneedle patch
column13: The invention provides a pregabalin slow-release type dissolving microneedle patch based on PLGA microspheres as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: dissolving pregabalin and hyaluronic acid in deionized water to form an inner water phase (W1); dissolving PLGA in dichloromethane to form an organic phase (O); performing ultrasonic emulsification on the internal water phase and the organic phase to form W/O primary emulsion; rapidly adding the primary emulsion into an external water phase (W2) containing PVA and NaCl to form a W1/O/W2 type multiple emulsion, and then carrying out solvent evaporation curing, centrifugal washing and freeze drying to obtain PLGA (at) PG microspheres; and uniformly dispersing the PLGA (at) PG microspheres in a hyaluronic acid solution, adding into a microneedle mold, vacuumizing, centrifuging, drying, and demolding the microneedle to obtain the dissolution type microneedle patch. By optimizing microsphere preparation, drug sustained release and microneedle patch preparation technologies are realized, and an efficient, safe and continuous local delivery platform is provided.

column12: Double-factor controlled release microsphere as well as preparation method and application thereof

Methods of use and preparation are also provided.

column12: Multi-layer sustained-release microsphere with anti-wrinkle effect as well as preparation method and application of multi-layer sustained-release microsphere
column13: The invention discloses a multi-layer sustained-release microsphere with an anti-wrinkle effect as well as a preparation method and application of the multi-layer sustained-release microsphere. The multilayer sustained release microsphere provided by the invention is prepared from the following components in percentage by weight: 5 to 15 percent of alligator oil, 65 to 80 percent of polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer (PLGA), 5 to 15 percent of chitosan and 0.1 to 5 percent of natural antioxidant. The multi-layer sustained release microsphere sequentially comprises an alligator oil-PLGA core sphere, a natural antioxidant-PLGA middle layer and a chitosan outer layer from inside to outside. The multilayer sustained-release microsphere prepared by adopting an electrostatic spinning technology has a porous multilayer structure, can realize accurate sustained release of different active components in each layer, prolongs the duration of a repairing effect, effectively reduces a burst release effect, and can ensure the stability of each active substance through layering treatment among the active substances, so that the stability of the active substances is improved. All the layers are released according to a specific rate and synergistically act on the skin, so that the utilization rate of active ingredients can be increased, waste is reduced, and meanwhile, the irritation risk to the skin is also reduced.

column12: DRUG DELIVERY FORMULATION COMPRISING REVERSE MICELLE-CONTAINING MICROCAPSULES FOR SIMULTANEOUS APPLICATION OF CHEMICAL THERAPY AND PHYSICAL THERAPY
column13: The present invention relates to a drug delivery formulation comprising microcapsules for simultaneous application of chemotherapy and physical therapy. The microcapsules of the present invention have porous PLGA as an internal skeleton and comprise reverse micelles. A hydrophilic drug for chemical therapy can be loaded and transported inside the reverse micelles, and a hydrophobic drug can be bound and transported outside the reverse micelles. In addition, reverse micelles fuse to cell membranes, thereby causing cell membrane instability, and thus can be used in physical therapy. Moreover, when the microcapsules are degraded to deliver the drug, remnants thereof can cause a photothermal effect around in the vicinity thereof, and thus the apoptosis effect of the drug delivery formulation of the present invention can be enhanced.

column12: SUSTAINED-RELEASE INJECTABLE COMPOSITION CONTAINING DUTASTERIDE
column13: The present invention relates to a sustained-release injectable composition containing dutasteride, which may exhibit a sustained dutasteride release effect for 3 months or more even when the dose of dutasteride is equal to or less than that of existing AVODART<sup>®</sup>, which is taken once a day, thereby exhibiting a long-acting drug effect by a single injection. In addition, the injectable composition may exhibit a therapeutic effect on benign prostatic hyperplasia, prostate cancer, and hair loss continuously for 3 months or more, may maintain an effective concentration of the drug at a constant level by controlling the release of the drug due to the constant average diameter of the microparticles contained in the sustained-release injectable composition, and may reduce foreign body sensation and pain when administered by injection to a patient.

column12: HYDROGEL COMPOSITION, METHOD FOR PRODUCING THE SAME, AND USE THEREOF FOR STEM CELL MIMETIC PEPTIDE SUPPLEMENTATION
column13: A method of preparing a hydrogel or spray composition comprising the steps of mixing a low viscosity diluent mix with a lyophilized protein mix to make a precursor solution on site just prior to application, mechanically mixing the precursor solution, and then adding an initiator mix to form a hydrogel. The hydrogel composition can include a broad-spectrum protein mix comprising at least one of a plurality of growth factors including bFGF, EGF, GDF-11, HGF, KGF, PDGF-AA, TGF-b1, and VEGF. The initiator mix can comprise at least one selected from the group consisting of a pH modifier, a photoinitiator, and a free radical initiator. The pH modifier can be selected from the group consisting of triethanolamine, NaOH, KOH, and sodium bicarbonate. The precursor solution can further comprise at additive including at least one selected from the group consisting of amino acid stabilizer, humectant, preservative, emollient, and anti-aging ingredients.

column12: SPECIFIC T CELL FOR PREVENTING OR TREATING CANCER, AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR
column13: The present disclosure relates to a method for preparing a cancer-specific T cell based on peripheral blood or a peripheral immune organ for preventing or treating cancer, specifically including steps of: first, isolating an immune cell from peripheral blood or the peripheral immune organ; then, co-incubating with a nanoparticle and/or a microparticle loaded with a tumor whole-cell antigen for a period of time to activate the cancer-specific T cell; then, isolating a cancer-specific T cell activated by the tumor antigen; and, reinfusing the cancer-specific T cell into the body to exert an anti-cancer effect after in vitro expansion. According to the nanoparticle or microparticle prepared by the present disclosure, a tumor antigen component is loaded onto the microparticle and/or the nanoparticle to activate the cancer-specific T cell, and then the cancer-specific T cell is expanded and reinfused into a patient for treating cancer or preventing recurrence or metastasis. The cancer-specific T cell isolated by a sorting method has high specificity, and may prevent or treat cancer by killing cancer cells after expansion.

column12: Combinatorial targeted therapy methods
column13: A combinatorial targeted therapy method for treating cancer, including metastatic cancer in a subject is provided, the method being designed to prevent unacceptable level of systemic toxicity in the subject and thus forced stoppage of the treatment, by performing initial molecular diagnostics to detect genomic alterations at each cancer site of the subject; for each cancer site, designing an initial combination targeted therapy by selecting a plurality of targeted drugs, based on the results of the initial molecular diagnostic at each cancer site; assigning each targeted drug to systemic or local delivery method, based on each targeted drug's properties; simultaneously treating all cancer sites according to the designed initial combination targeted therapy for each site, by delivering each targeted drug according to assigned delivery method to each targeted drug; and monitoring the progress of the cancer at each cancer site by performing follow-up molecular diagnostics at each cancer site.

column12: Uniaxially-aligned nanofiber scaffolds and methods for producing and using same
column13: Oral cavity wound healing occurs in an environment that sustains ongoing physical trauma and is rich in bacteria. Patients undergoing cleft palate repair have a high degree of wound healing complications, such as oronasal fistula (ONF) formation. Following hard palate injury, ONF was created that demonstrated little change in pro-regenerative monocytes LY6Clo monocytes; however, there were increased M2 macrophages observed. Delivery of FTY720 nanofiber scaffolds following hard palate injury prevented ONF formation, allowed complete wound healing and was associated with increased LY6Clo monocytes and pro-regenerative M2 macrophages. Evaluation of interleukin gene expression revealed reduction in pro-inflammatory IL1 and IL6 and increased expression of pro-regenerative IL10 with FTY720 nanofiber delivery. The ability of FTY720 scaffolds to increase LY6Clo monocytes, increase M2 macrophages and alter the interleukin expression during hard palate mucosal healing demonstrates the ability of a FTY720-based autotherapy to improve oral cavity wound healing.

column12: PLGA-minoxidil microneedle with near-infrared response and preparation method of PLGA-minoxidil microneedle
column13: The invention discloses a PLGA (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid))-minoxidil microneedle with near-infrared response and a preparation method of the PLGA-minoxidil microneedle. The PLGA-minoxidil microneedle with the near infrared response comprises PLGA-minoxidil microspheres, lanthanum hexaboride nanoparticles, a base body and a needle body, wherein the PLGA-minoxidil microspheres are arranged on the base body; wherein the PLGA-minoxidil microspheres and the lanthanum hexaboride nanoparticles are distributed in the needle body; and the base body and the needle body are made of a combination of PVA (polyvinyl alcohol) 1788 and PVA 1799. The PLGA-minoxidil microspheres are combined with the hydrogel microneedle with near-infrared response, controlled release of MXD is achieved on the microstructure through cooperation of the microporous structure of the microspheres and the near-infrared response effect of lanthanum hexaboride nanoparticles, the side effect of the medicine is effectively reduced, the concentration of the medicine in the body can be better maintained, and the drug delivery effect is improved. A better treatment effect is achieved; macroscopically, the prepared hydrogel system has relatively good mechanical properties, and can provide a stable drug delivery channel and drug delivery efficiency.

The artificial exosome disclosed by the invention combines the stability of the PLGA nanoparticles and the biocompatibility of the lipid membrane, and provides new possibility for a drug delivery system.

column12: Slow-release injection containing levosalbutamol and preparation process thereof
column13: The invention provides a slow-release injection containing levosalbutamol and a preparation process thereof, the injection combines a ginkgo leaf extract, a resveratrol extract, vitamin B6, vitamin C, tea polyphenol and other auxiliary components, and through specific preparation steps, the injection can be prepared into the slow-release injection containing levosalbutamol. Comprising the following steps: preparing raw materials, mixing and dissolving, preparing a slow-release carrier, adjusting pH, filtering, filling, sterilizing and the like, thereby obtaining the injection with the slow-release effect. Wherein the ginkgo biloba extract and the resveratrol extract are obtained through specific extraction and purification steps, and the activity and purity of the ginkgo biloba extract and the resveratrol extract are ensured. Polylactic acid-glycolide (PLGA) is used as a sustained-release carrier material and is combined with the active component to form a stable sustained-release system. Every 20 ml of the injection contains 0.2-1 mg of levosalbutamol, and the injection is suitable for a treatment scene where the drug concentration needs to be maintained for a long time. The injection is simple and controllable in preparation process, the obtained product is good in stability and remarkable in slow release effect, and a new choice is provided for treatment of respiratory tract obstructive diseases.

column12: Method for determining content of glucose in star-shaped PLGA (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid)) and pretreatment method
column13: The invention discloses a method for determining the content of glucose in star-shaped PLGA and a pretreatment method, a mixed solution of triethylamine and methanol is adopted as a hydrolysis solvent to perform pretreatment on PLGA or PLA in a polyester compound so as to form a stable hydrolysis solution, and the hydrolysis method is adopted to rapidly extract the bonded glucose in the star-shaped PLGA, so that the content of the glucose in the star-shaped PLGA is determined. Then, HPLC-ELSD is used for detection, and the content of glucose is calculated according to the linear regression equation and the logarithm value of the glucose peak area in the chromatogram of the sample to be detected. The detection method is easy and convenient to operate, rapid in detection and high in sensitivity, quantitative detection of trace glucose in the star-shaped PLGA caused by glucose can be achieved, characterization methods and quality control methods of the quality attribute of the star-shaped PLGA are enriched, research on performance parameters of a sustained and controlled release preparation with the star-shaped PLGA as a carrier is facilitated, and the application prospect is wide. And a reference is provided for evaluating process change and quality difference of the sustained and controlled release preparation.

column13: Long acting parenteral pharmaceutical compositions comprising a therapeutically effective amount of glatiramer are provided. The depot form is suitable for subcutaneous or intramuscular implantation or injection.

column12: Brain-targeted nano-carrier as well as preparation method and application thereof

column12: DRUG DELIVERY DEVICES HAVING SEPARABLE MICRONEEDLES AND METHODS
column13: Drug delivery devices and methods are provided for delivering one or more drugs into a biological tissue. The devices include microneedles that may be separable from the drug delivery devices, control drug release rate and/or direction, or a combination thereof. When the microneedles are separable, a force applied to the drug delivery devices may be effective to penetrate a biological tissue with the microneedles and then to separate the microneedles from the drug delivery devices. column12: DRUG DELIVERY SYSTEM FOR TARGETED CANCER TREATMENT
column13: The present invention provides a drug delivery system for targeted cancer treatment, comprising: a GEM-PLGA complex, wherein the complex contains 150 mg of GEM-PLGA, equivalent to 25 mg of gemcitabine (GEM); Acetone in an amount of 10 ml as a solvent for the GEM-PLGA complex; Polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) solution in an amount of 20 ml, with a concentration of 2% w/v, used as a stabilizer for the formulation; and a Layer-by-Layer nanoparticle (LbL-NP) formulation encapsulating the GEM-PLGA complex and configured to release GEM in a controlled manner upon administration. The physiochemical properties of Caps-GEM LbL NPs was evaluated such as particle size, zeta potential, percent entrapment efficiency (% EE), loading of drug and In-vitro drug release behavior. The surface morphology of LbL NP's was evaluated by scanning electronic microscopy (SEM).

column12: Confined-range light-operated anti-tumor composite hydrogel drug reservoir as well as preparation method and application of confined-range light-operated anti-tumor composite hydrogel drug reservoir
column13: The invention discloses a range-limited light-operated anti-tumor composite hydrogel drug reservoir and a preparation method and application thereof.The light-responsive drug-loaded nano hydrogel is loaded into a temperature-sensitive hydrogel system to form the range-limited hydrogel drug reservoir with light-operated drug release, the preparation method comprises the steps that PEG, LA and GA are added into a three-necked flask for an oil bath reaction, and the temperature-sensitive hydrogel system is obtained; after the reaction, purifying and freeze-drying to obtain a PLGA-PEG-PLGA block copolymer; the PLGA-PEG-PLGA segmented copolymer is dissolved in ultrapure water, and a PLGA-PEG-PLGA sol is obtained; and dissolving the drug-loaded PDA (at) P (NIPAAm-co-AM) nano hydrogel into the PLGA-PEG-PLGA sol, so as to obtain the confined light-operated anti-tumor composite hydrogel drug reservoir. The confined light-operated anti-tumor composite hydrogel drug reservoir has light-responsive drug delivery performance, not only has space-time controllability of drug release, but also weakens the problems of photothermal effect and the like in light-assisted therapy, so that accurate tumor therapy can be realized.

column12: DELIVERY OF Mg FOR PERIODONTAL TREATMENT
column13: The disclosed concept includes systems and methods for the delivery of magnesium to a patient to modulate the human immune system and create an anti-inflammatory periodontal environment to support tissue regeneration. Various mechanisms for the delivery of magnesium include magnesium-polymer (PLGA) microparticles, magnesium-polymer (PLGA) electrospun fibers, and/or magnesium-polymer (PLGA) implant devices, e.g., scaffolds, constructed of the magnesium-polymer (PLGA) electrospun fibers. These mechanisms provide a controlled- and/or sustained-release of magnesium for the treatment of one or more of periodontitis, peri-implantitis, and bone defects. The magnesium-polymer (PLGA) microparticles include magnesium metal nanopowder that is coated with a fatty acid or lipid.

column12: Targeted substance mediated nucleic acid nano preparation and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention belongs to but not limited to the technical field of biological medicine, and discloses a target-mediated nucleic acid nano preparation and a preparation method thereof, the target-mediated nucleic acid nano preparation comprises a cationic lipid: C6A1 lipid, a polymer: PLGA, a modified lipid: DSPEPEG2000, and a target: a specific antibody or peptide fragment; a composite structure of cationic lipid and polymer nanoparticles is adopted, a target is modified on the surface of a nano preparation to realize targeted delivery, the target comprises an antibody, a peptide or a small molecule ligand, PEG is modified on the surfaces of the liposome and the nanoparticles, the stability is improved, and the circulation time is prolonged. The targeted nucleic acid nano preparation prepared by the invention can realize efficient and safe nucleic acid and drug delivery.

column12: Nanoparticle immunologic adjuvant with immune synergistic effect and preparation method of nanoparticle immunologic adjuvant
column13: The preparation method comprises the following steps: selecting PLGA (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid)) with biocompatibility and biodegradability as a carrier material, loading an immunopotentiator alpha-tocopherol on PLGA nano-particles, and preparing the nano-particle immunologic adjuvant by using a nano-precipitation method, so as to obtain the nano-particle immunologic adjuvant with an immune synergistic effect. By controlling the polymer concentration and the drug concentration in the preparation process, the average particle size of the drug-loaded nano-particles is 90-120nm, the monodispersion coefficient is less than 0.2, the particle size of the product is uniform and stable, the encapsulation efficiency reaches 80% or more, the content of alpha-tocopherol in the nano-particles is 1-30%, and the drug-loaded nano-particles have a sustained-release effect of one month or more. The PLGA nanoparticles loaded with alpha-tocopherol can promote proliferation of mouse macrophages and enhance secretion of cell inflammatory cytokines and expression of surface costimulatory molecules, have a synergistic enhancement effect of the PLGA nanoparticles and alpha-tocopherol, and can be used as an effective immunologic adjuvant.

column12: Neural suture line and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a nerve suture line and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: step 1, mixing type I collagen powder, glycerol and glutaraldehyde according to a weight ratio of 95: (4-10): (1-5); 2, preheating and melting the mixture, then carrying out melt spinning, and carrying out cooling, stretching and surface treatment on spun tows to obtain a primary suture line product; step 3, mixing the PLGA solution and the dexamethasone solution according to a volume ratio of 9: (1-6), and carrying out high-speed shearing emulsification on the mixed solution; 4, coating, drying and curing, surface treatment and sterilization treatment are conducted on the primary suture line product through an impregnation method, and the nerve suture line is obtained. The suture line prepared by adopting the preparation method of the nerve suture line can realize sustained release of dexamethasone, and is beneficial to reducing inflammatory response at the early stage of nerve injury and promoting nerve repair; in addition, dexamethasone also has the effect of reducing foreign body reaction, rejection reaction of an organism after the suture line is implanted can be reduced, and the biocompatibility of the suture line is improved.

column12: MICROPARTICLES CONTAINING MOXIDECTIN AND SUSTAINED-RELEASE INJECTION COMPOSITION CONTAINING SAME
column13: The present invention relates to microparticles containing moxidectin, and a preparation method thereof. Unlike conventional heartworm prevention drugs that have a short half-life and thus require daily or monthly administration, moxidectin is continuously released for at least three months and thus the effect of preventing heartworms can be maintained for at least three months when the microparticles containing moxidectin are administered. In addition, microparticles which have a constant average diameter and a narrow diameter distribution are prepared so that initial over-release of moxidectin is prevented when the microparticles are administered, the release of the drug can be controlled to keep constant the concentration of moxidectin that is valid for at least three months, and foreign body sensation and pain can be reduced when the microparticles are applied in the form of an injection.

column12: METHOD FOR PREPARING MICROPARTICLES CONTAINING MOXIDECTIN AND SUSTAINED-RELEASE INJECTABLE COMPOSITION COMPRISING MICROPARTICLES PREPARED BY SAME PREPARATION METHOD

In addition, by preparing microparticles having a constant average particle diameter and a narrow diameter distribution width, even when the microparticles are administered, the initial over-release of moxidectin is prevented, and the release of the drug is controlled so that a concentration of moxidectin effective for three months or longer can be kept constant, and when the microparticles are applied as an injection, foreign body sensation and pain can be reduced.

column12: Osteochondral repair 3D stent of insulin drug sustained-release microenvironment and preparation method of osteochondral repair 3D stent
column13: The invention discloses an osteochondral repair 3D stent of an insulin drug sustained release microenvironment and a preparation method thereof, the stent is composed of a 3D printed PCL main body stent, a PDA surface modification coating and PLGA nanoparticles wrapping insulin and having drug controlled release efficacy, the diameter of stent fibers of the PCL main body stent is 200 [mu] m, the fiber spacing is 400 [mu] m, and the diameter of the PLGA nanoparticles is 100 [mu] m. The PDA coating is used for surface modification of a PCL main body stent for 3D printing, and the PLGA nanoparticles wrapping insulin are adsorbed on the surface of the stent. The diameter, arrangement, spacing, aperture and porosity of fibers of the stent are controllable, the stent has the characteristic of chondrogenesis stimulation of a drug microenvironment, stem cells are easy to adhere and migrate through PDA modification, cartilage layer cells can be well proliferated in the stent, the cell phenotype can be maintained, more ECM can be generated, and the stent has a good application prospect. And meanwhile, the ingrowth of subchondral bone layer blood vessels and bone tissues is facilitated.

column12: Drug balloon catheter and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the field of drug delivery, and particularly relates to a drug balloon catheter and a preparation method thereof. The invention provides a medicine balloon catheter. The medicine balloon catheter comprises a balloon catheter body, a medicine storage layer and a medicine coating, wherein the outer surface of the balloon catheter body is sequentially coated with the medicine storage layer and the medicine coating. The medicine storage layer comprises one or more layers; when the drug balloon catheter is used for delivery, drugs on the outermost layer enter blood vessels preferentially and are continuously absorbed and metabolized and eliminated along with the half-life period and elimination kinetics of the drugs, and the anti-proliferation effect of the drugs is achieved. The first layer of the microspheres in the storage layer preferentially enters tissues and reaches saturation concentration, so that most of the microspheres are attached to the blood vessel wall, the modification of chitosan increases the contact between the PLGA microspheres and the blood vessel wall, a large amount of medicine is released after the structure of the storage layer collapses, and the released large amount of medicine enters the blood vessel to play a role.

column13: Provided are microspheres in which a physiologically active substance is homogeneously dispersed, and a sustained release preparation containing the same. The coefficient of variation of the ratio calculated in the six regions is 0.35 or less. The microspheres of the present invention can appropriately control the initial release amount of the physiologically active substance and the release rate during the subsequent release period, and can continuously release the physiologically active substance in a living body for a certain period of time.

column12: Citric acid fentanyl coated PLGA-PEG nano-microsphere and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of medicines, in particular to citric acid fentanyl-coated PLGA-PEG nano microspheres and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: step S1, preparing a citric acid fentanyl citrate solution and a PLGA-PEG solution; step S2, dropwise adding the citric acid fentanyl solution into the PLGA-PEG solution, mixing, and carrying out ultrasonic emulsification to obtain primary emulsion; s3, dropwise adding the primary emulsion into a PVA (Polyvinyl Alcohol) solution, mixing, and carrying out ultrasonic emulsification to obtain multiple emulsion; and step S4, dropwise adding the multiple emulsion into water, stirring to volatilize the organic solvent, and performing centrifugal filtration to obtain the citric acid fentanyl coated PLGA-PEG nano-microspheres. The PLGA-PEG nano-carrier is adopted as a drug carrier to carry the citric acid fentanyl citrate, and compared with an existing oral administration citric acid fentanyl citrate preparation, slow release of the citric acid fentanyl citrate can be achieved.

column12: PLGA (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid)) with linear degradation behavior in vitro as well as preparation method and application of PLGA
column13: The invention discloses PLGA (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid)) with linear degradation in vitro degradation behavior as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of polymer medical materials and preparation thereof. According to the invention, 3-methyl glycolate is used as a raw material, and the completely alternating PLGA with regioselectivity greater than 99% is prepared through ring-opening polymerization of 3-methyl glycolate only at glycolic acid sites. The completely alternating PLGA prepared by the invention is a new material synthesized for the first time, has the characteristics of higher melting point, better thermal stability, higher crystallinity and linear degradation compared with a non-completely alternating PLGA material, is expected to be used as a novel controllable drug delivery material, and has a good application prospect.

column12: NANOPARTICLE COATED WITH SQUAMOUS CARCINOMA CELL MEMBRANE, AS WELL AS PREPARATION METHOD AND APPLICATION THEREOF
column13: The present invention relates to the technical field of nano-drug delivery systems, in particular to a nanoparticle coated with a squamous carcinoma cell membrane, as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The nanoparticle coated with a squamous carcinoma cell membrane includes a nucleus and a coat, where the nucleus is formed by coating doxorubicin with poly lactic-co-glycolic acid (PLGA), and the coat is a squamous carcinoma membrane into which phospholipid-modified indocyanine green is integrated. The preparation method thereof includes: preparing a squamous carcinoma cell membrane; preparing squamous carcinoma cell vesicles; and modifying photosensitizers, loading the modified photosensitizers on the squamous carcinoma cell membrane vesicles, mixing the treated photosensitizers with nanoparticles., performing extruding repeatedly with a liposome extruder, and obtaining the nanoparticles coated with the squamous carcinoma cell membrane vesicles. According to this technical solution, the nanoparticle and the preparation method overcome the shortcomings of low solubility, low bioavailability and poor targeting of doxorubicin and indocyanine green, achieve an increase in, solubility and prolonging of blood circulation time of a chemotherapy drug and the photosensitizer, farther implement targeting at a cancer location, and implement accurate treatment accordingly.

column12: LONG-ACTING SUSTAINED-RELEASE PHARMACEUTICAL PREPARATION AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR
column13: A long-acting sustained-release pharmaceutical preparation and a preparation method therefor. The long-acting sustained-release pharmaceutical preparation is a microsphere preparation, which comprises brexpiprazole and PLGA, wherein the content of brexpiprazole is 45%-75% of the total weight of the microsphere, the content of PLGA is 55%-25% of the total weight of the microsphere, and PLGA has a viscosity of 0.15-0.25 dl/g and a molecular weight of 8000-32000. The microsphere has a relatively high drug loading capacity, can effectively reduce the administration dosage and reduce the pain in patients during subcutaneous or intramuscular administration; and the prepared sustained-release microsphere has no burst release phenomenon, and has a stable change in blood drug concentration within an effective period of release in rats.

column12: Bionic nano-drug delivery system based on PD1 engineered cancer cell membrane and construction method of bionic nano-drug delivery system

column12: POLYMERSOMES AND METHODS OF USING AND MAKING THE SAME
column13: The past few decades have witnessed explosive development in drug delivery systems. However, in vivo delivery suffers from non-specific distribution in non-targeted organs or tissues, which may cause undesired side effects and even genotoxicity. Here, a general strategy that enables tuning the tropism of polymersomes for liver- and spleen-selective delivery is reported. By using careful design polymersome for organ targeted delivery of a bioactive molecule are disclosed including a cationic polymer of a triblock copolymer of PEG- PLGA- positively charged amino acid/ positively charged oligopeptide; and a helper polymer of a di-block copolymer helper group-PEG-PLGA. A library screening approach allowed spleen-targeted and liver-targeted polymersome to be identified. Near-infrared (NIR-II) fluorescence imaging allows for in vivo dynamic evaluation of their spatial and temporal accumulation in specific tissues. The polymersomes may be used as a systemic nanocarrier to co-deliver the antigen and adjuvant, which remarkably boost splenic immune responses in acute myeloid leukemia, melanoma, and melanoma lung metastasis mouse models.

The preparation method comprises the following steps: respectively dissolving the PLGA and the active component in an organic solvent; adding the dissolved active components into a PLGA solution, adjusting the pH value, and homogenizing to form an emulsion; adding the emulsion into a surfactant, and homogenizing; removing the organic solvent, centrifuging and washing; and freezing and drying to obtain the slow-release precise nutrient for nourishing and protecting the liver. column13: Provided herein are pharmaceutical formulations, methods of manufacturing thereof, and methods of treatment. The pharmaceutical formulations are adapted to serve as a pay load on or in a microbot, and comprise a tablet of a therapeutically effective dose of a pharmaceutical agent and have dimensions such that the tablet may fit on or in the microbot. The pharmaceutical formulation may be formed into, e.g., a cylinder or spheroid of 1 mm dimension, and the pharmaceutical agent may be a small molecule drug, a peptide, a peptoid, a biologic drug, cells, or any combination thereof. Thus, the pharmaceutical formulation of the present description offers delivery of targeted therapy at a locus in a subject, e.g., a tumor.

column12: Preparation method of ginsenoside Rh4 lipid nanoparticle sustained release preparation
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a ginsenoside Rh4 lipid nanoparticle sustained release preparation. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing PLGA-PEG-PLGA gel particles loaded with ginsenoside Rh4, then, carrying out liposome encapsulation on the gel particles, and then, carrying out high-pressure homogenization or ultrasonication, so as to form the ginsenoside Rh4 lipid nanoparticles. In the preparation of the PLGA-PEG-PLGA gel particles loaded with ginsenoside Rh4, a triblock copolymer PLGA-PEG-PLGA is used as a gel material, and toxic and harmful organic solvents such as diethyl ether, acetone, ethanol, trichloromethane and the like are not used at all, so that the safety of the process and the product is improved. The ginsenoside Rh4 lipid nanoparticles are good in stability, can effectively slow down the drug release speed and achieve the sustained release effect, have wide application prospects, and have reference significance for development of drug sustained release preparations.

column12: A METHOD FOR PREPARING MICROPARTICLES FOR DRUG DELIVERY
column13: Disclosed is a method for preparing microparticles for drug delivery. The method comprises providing a mold comprising multiple individual, open compartments arranged on a first surface of the mold. The open compartments are separated from each other by one or more edges. Each edge has a width of 5 µm or less. The method comprises coating the first surface of the mold with a mold layer comprising a biocompatible and/or biodegradable material having a first release characteristic at a first condition. The method comprises loading the compartments coated with the mold layer with a pharmaceutical composition comprising a drug substance. The method comprises coating the first surface of the mold with a top layer comprising a biocompatible and/or biodegradable material having a second release characteristic at the first condition for provision of closed microparticles in the multiple individual compartments. The method comprises separating the closed microparticles by cutting the mold layer and the top layer using the one or more edges. By cutting the mold layer and the top layer using the one or more edges discrete microparticles are provided.

column12: Nano motor and application thereof in preparation of anti-tumor immunotherapy drugs
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines and nano preparations, and particularly relates to a nano motor and application thereof in preparation of anti-tumor immunotherapy drugs. The nano motor is composed of a nano carrier, a ferroptosis drug and an ultrasonic enhancer. Polyethylene glycol (PEG) modified polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer (PLGA) nanoparticles are preferably selected as the nano-carrier, gambogic acid is preferably selected as the ferroptosis drug, and perfluorobromooctane is preferably selected as the ultrasonic enhancer. The nanomotor is prepared by a nanoprecipitation method or a microfluidic method. The materials are simple and easy to obtain, the preparation operation is simple and convenient, the prepared nano motor has excellent high intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) response performance, deep driving and efficient accumulation towards a focus part can be realized under the action of HIFU, and controllable release of a medicine at a tumor part is realized. Meanwhile, the nano motor can cooperate with HIFU to enhance the ferroptosis effect of tumor cells, activate the anti-tumor immune effect of the body and inhibit the growth and metastasis of tumors.

column12: Injectable temperature-sensitive sustained release preparation and preparation method thereof

column12: Method and device for preparing PLGA (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid)) drug controlled release microspheres
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method and device of PLGA (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid)) drug controlled release microspheres, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: respectively preparing an oil phase and a water phase, mixing and stirring to obtain a pre-emulsion, carrying out rapid membrane emulsification on the pre-emulsion to obtain an emulsion, shunting the emulsion, and carrying out rapid curing in a continuous flow heat exchange manner to obtain the PLGA drug controlled release microspheres. And filtering, washing and drying the solid-liquid mixture to obtain the PLGA drug controlled release microspheres. According to the invention, the PLGA drug controlled release microspheres are rapidly cured in a manner of continuous flow heat exchange after emulsion shunting, so that the problems of irregular form, long curing time, crystallization, low encapsulation efficiency and unstable drug loading capacity of the microspheres are solved.

column12: SUSTAINED-RELEASE INJECTABLE COMPOSITION CONTAINING NALTREXONE AND METHOD FOR PREPARING SAME
column13: The present invention relates to a sustained-release injectable composition containing naltrexone, and a method for producing the same. column12: Acid response nano-material for promoting revascularization and preparation method of acid response nano-material
column13: The invention discloses an acid response nano material for promoting revascularization and a preparation method thereof. Comprising polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer (PLGA) nanoparticles, an HIF-1alpha transfected MSC conditioned culture medium and an acid response factor CG-CO2 which are loaded in the PLGA nanoparticles, and an erythrocyte membrane and a platelet membrane which coat the surfaces of the PLGA nanoparticles. According to the nano-drug delivery system for regulating and controlling MSC paracrine angiogenesis promoting active factors based on HIF-1alpha, after entering a focus position, acid response bomb effect rapid drug release is achieved, MSC highly expresses angiogenesis biological active factors, and the ischemia position targeting capacity is enhanced.

column12: SUSTAINED RELEASE INJECTABLE FORMULATIONS USING APROTIC POLAR SOLVENTS
column13: The present invention concerns the use of aprotic polar solvents, water, and an ionization stabilizing agent to prepare stable therapeutic formulations, particularly sustained release formulations, of a variety of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), such as, e.g., levothyroxine. In particular, the invention concerns the use of aprotic polar solvents and at least one ionization stabilizing agent to prepare stable therapeutic formulations of a variety of APIs by dissolving at least one API in an aprotic polar solvent system to produce a stable sustained release therapeutic formulation useful in treating, preventing and/or diagnosing diseases or physical disorders in humans and veterinary animals. The invention also provides methods of manufacturing such formulations.

column12: Stable sustained release therapeutic compositions in aprotic polar solvents and methods of manufacturing the same
column13: The present invention relates to the use of aprotic polar solvents and an ionization stabilizing agent to prepare storage stable sustained release therapeutic formulations by dissolving a therapeutic agent (active ingredient) in an aprotic polar solvent system that can then be administered to patients suffering from or predisposed to a variety of physical conditions or disorders, notably hypoglycemia. In certain embodiments, the invention is directed to formulations comprising one or more therapeutic agents, as well as methods of making such formulations, comprising at least one therapeutic agent dissolved in an aprotic polar solvent such as DMSO, comprising at least one ionization stabilizing excipient (suitably, a mineral acid) and at least one sustained release modifier (suitably, a divalent cation-donating compound such as a zinc salt and/or a polymer such as a PLGA) in concentrations sufficient to impart physical and chemical stability to the therapeutic agent and to produce a formulation that results in a sustained release of the therapeutic agent into the bloodstream of an animal to which the formulation has been administered. The invention also relates to methods of producing such storage stable sustained release therapeutic formulations and to methods of treating, preventing and diagnosing certain physical conditions and disorders, notably hypoglycemia, by administering such storage stable sustained release therapeutic formulations to a patient.

column13: Disclosed are pharmaceutical compositions containing micronized antibodies encapsulated and/or dispersed in polymeric particles for antibody delivery. column12: Oral periodontal local drug sustained-release polymeric membrane material, preparation method and application
column13: The invention discloses an oral periodontal local drug sustained-release polymeric membrane material, which is prepared by loading metformin on hollow mesoporous silicon to obtain drug-loaded hollow mesoporous silicon, and compounding the drug-loaded hollow mesoporous silicon with a polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the polymeric membrane material. The preparation method comprises the following steps: S1, preparing hollow meso-porous silicon; s2, preparation of drug-loaded hollow mesoporous silicon; and S3, preparing the polymeric membrane material. The oral periodontal local drug sustained-release polymeric membrane material disclosed by the invention can improve the hydrophobicity of a PLGA electrospun membrane and continuously and slowly release metformin, has good in-vitro biocompatibility, and is expected to be used as a local sustained-release biological material for personalized treatment of periodontitis patients suffering from diabetes in the future.

OA treatment is a periodic injection regimen that provides long-term in vivo controlled release of PFD to modulate and attenuate the progression of OA.

column12: Biomimetic nanoscale drug delivery system as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a biomimetic nanoscale drug delivery system and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of medicines. Comprising the following steps: (1) synthesizing Ag2S quantum dots for NIR-II; (2) extracting 4T1 cancer cell membrane protein by using a cell membrane protein extraction kit; (3) dissolving the Ag2S quantum dots, paclitaxel and a PD-L1 inhibitor in dimethyl sulfoxide to obtain a solution A; dissolving PLGA (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid)) in dichloromethane to obtain a solution B; then uniformly mixing and dispersing the solution A and the solution B, and continuously stirring, centrifuging and washing in a dark environment to obtain AgPP-coated PLGA nanoparticles; (4) incubating the 4T1 cancer cell membrane protein and the AgPP-coated PLGA nano particles, and extruding by using polycarbonate porous membranes with gradually reduced pore diameters in sequence to obtain AgPP-coated P-coated M nano particles; and (5) continuously stirring the AgPP-P-M nanoparticles at the temperature of 0 DEG C, centrifuging and then collecting. The compound provided by the invention can selectively interact with tumor cells, not only causes cell death, but also stimulates immunogenic cell death, thereby activating a host immune system to resist tumors.

column12: POLYMERIC NANOPARTICLES FOR LONG ACTING DELIVERY OF A PEPTIDE AND METHODS OF MAKING AND USING THEREOF
column13: Disclosed herein are polymeric nanoparticles containing peptides, which provide low burst release and sustained, delivery of the peptides, and pharmaceutical compositions thereof. The polymeric nanoparticles contain a peptide encapsulated or dispersed therein. The nanoparticles can provide sustained release of the peptide, for example, less than 20% of the peptide is released initially (at time 0 hour) following placement into a phosphate buffered saline at pH 7.4 at 37 ̊C and room pressure. Methods for micronizing a peptide and for preparing polymeric nanoparticles containing solid, micronized peptides are also disclosed. The preparation methods use miscible solvent and non-solvent pairs in phase inversion nanoencapsulation processes. The Gibbs energy of mixing (ΔGMix) between the solvent and non-solvent can be tailored to achieve desired particle size, encapsulation efficiency, and release profile.

column12: METHOD AND COMPOSITIONS FOR THE TREATMENT AND PROPHYLAXIS OF SUBSTANCE-RELATED AND/OR ADDICTIVE DISORDERS
column13: Pharmaceutical compositions and dosage forms containing low doses of aripiprazole (Formula (I)) or its derivatives/congeners/analogues (e.g., brexpiprazole or cariprazine), and topiramate (Formula (II)) are provided. A method of treatment and/or prophylaxis of substance-related and/or addictive disorders by administering a combination of aripiprazole, or its congeners/analogues/derivatives (e.g., brexpiprazole or cariprazine), and topiramate is also provided. The aripiprazole is generally administered in immediate release in a daily dose in the range of 1.5 mg to 6 mg, in combination with a controlled release formulation daily dose of topiramate of 23 to 92 mg. Methods of administration of low doses of topiramate and aripiprazole or its congeners/analogues (e.g., brexpiprazole or cariprazine) are also provided.

column12: Triptorelin acetate sustained release microsphere and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to triptorelin acetate sustained release microspheres and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the triptorelin acetate sustained-release microspheres disclosed by the invention comprises the following steps: 1) dissolving triptorelin acetate in water to prepare an internal water phase solution; dissolving PLGA in an organic solution to prepare an oil phase solution; dissolving PVA in water to prepare an external water phase solution; 2) mixing the internal water phase solution and the oil phase solution, and emulsifying to form primary emulsion; mixing the primary emulsion with the external water phase solution, and emulsifying to form multiple emulsion; and 3) curing and freeze-drying the multiple emulsion to obtain the triptorelin acetate sustained-release microspheres. By adopting the method disclosed by the invention, the triptorelin acetate sustained-release microspheres which are low in burst release and can meet the castration level and high maintenance rate can be prepared.

column12: Exosome sustained-release porous microspheres and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention provides a preparation method of exosome sustained-release porous microspheres, which comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing nano-hydroxyapatite (nHAP) with high dispersion stability, so that the biocompatibility and the stability of the nano-hydroxyapatite can be improved; the nHAP/PLGA-PDA porous microspheres are prepared through a double-emulsion method, then dopamine (DA) is polymerized on the surfaces of the microspheres in situ, a PDA biological coating is formed on the surfaces of the microspheres, the loading efficiency of Exo on the microspheres is improved, the release period of Exo on the microspheres is prolonged, and the nHAP/PLGA-PDA porous microspheres are obtained. column12: TARGETING DELIVERY SYSTEM LOADED WITH WHOLE-CELL COMPONENTS AND USE THEREOF

column12: PFD LOADED MICROSPHERES AND METHOD FOR PREPARING INJECTABLE COMPOSITE MICROSPHERE HYDROGEL SOLUTION FROM SAME
column13: A therapeutic sustained delivery vehicle (TSDV) includes a plurality of microparticles with pirfenidone (PFD) within a poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid) (PLGA) matrix, where the microparticles are suspended in a hyaluronic acid (HA) solution. This suspension of microparticles are useful for injection into a joint that suffers from osteoarthritis (OA) inflammation and pain. The microparticles are microspheres formed by forming a solution of PDF and PLGA in a water insoluble organic solvent that is emulsified with an aqueous solution. Upon evaporation of the organic solvent the resulting microspheres are separated from the suspension. The microspheres are suspended in a HA solution. An OA treatment is a periodic injection protocol that provides a long-term in vivo controlled-release PFD to modulate and attenuate the OA progression.

column12: BIOLOGICAL FUNCTION COMPOSITE POROUS POLYESTER MICROSPHERES AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR

column12: COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS TO PROMOTE BRAIN HEALTH
column13: The present disclosure provides a composition comprising an active ingredient that is encapsulated in suspension of particles comprising a biodegradable polymer containing an effective amount of the active ingredient, wherein the particles are configured to bypass the blood brain barrier, wherein the nutraceutical agent is synthetic D-beta hydroxybutyrate, and wherein targeted delivery is to the brain. It further provides a method for promoting healing of the brain after a traumatic brain injury comprising neuroinflammation and a method for promoting brain health. It further provides a pharmaceutical composition for use in reducing risk of brain damage due to an acquired brain injury in a subject susceptible to, or otherwise at risk of, the acquired brain injury, said composition comprising a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier and a formulation comprising a therapeutic amount of an API, wherein the API is a synthetic D-beta-hydroxybutyrate, wherein the treatment comprises targeted delivery to the olfactory region of the nasal cavity of the subject by administering the composition intranasally (a) before the subject participates in an event where an acquired brain injury is a known risk; (b) after the subject participates in the event for use in treating symptoms of the acquired brain injury of the subject comprising neuroinflammation; or both, wherein the treatment is neuroprotective.

column12: Lacrimal implants and related methods
column13: Lacrimal implants and related methods providing secure, wedgable retention within a lacrimal punctum and associated canaliculus of an eye are disclosed. The lacrimal implants can comprise an implant body configured for at least partial insertion through the lacrimal punctum and into the canaliculus. The implant body can include first and second portions, and can extend from a proximal end of the first portion defining a longitudinal proximal axis to a distal end of the second portion defining a longitudinal distal axis. The implant body can be configured such that, when implanted using an integral dilator, an angled intersection exists between the proximal and distal axes. In this way, at least a portion of the implant body can be biased against at least a portion of the lacrimal canaliculus located at or more distal to a canalicular curvature, thereby retaining an implanted position of the lacrimal implant using anatomical structures.

column13: A method of forming a microneedle array can include forming a microneedle array that has one or more bioactive component. The microneedle array can include a base portion and plurality of microneedles extending from the base portion, and the one or more bioactive components can be combined with other components to exhibit specific release kinetics when the microneedle array is inserted into the skin of a patient.

A process for the preparation of a pharmaceutical formulation comprising microparticles of levothyroxine with poly(D,L-lactide-co-glycolide) polymer as herein defined is also provided.

column12: Micellar microsphere with core-shell structure as well as preparation method and application of micelle microsphere
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, and particularly relates to a core-shell structure micelle microsphere as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The core-shell structure micelle microsphere has an outer shell formed by amphiphilic lipid, an inner shell formed by a hydrophilic chain polymer, and a drug molecule core wrapped by a copolymer with a net structure. Effective transportation of the medicine can be achieved through the two-layer shell structure, the loss of the medicine in the conveying process is reduced, and the utilization rate of the medicine is increased; and the sustained release of the medicine is realized by taking the wrapped medicine molecules as an inner core. The core-shell material is optimized, and amphiphilic phospholipid is selected as an outer shell, so that the biocompatibility and the drug delivery efficiency are improved; a hydrophilic chain polymer is selected as an inner layer shell, so that burst release of the medicine is effectively prevented; the mPEG-PLGA block copolymer is selected to wrap drug molecules, so that sudden release of the drug is further prevented, the drug release rate is controllable, and complex requirements in actual use can be met.

column12: Decreased adhesivity receptor-targeted nanoparticles for Fn14-positive tumors
column13: Metastatic triple negative breast cancer (TNBC) still carries a dismal prognosis with the current treatment paradigms. The effectiveness of drug treatment for many solid tumors such as TNBC is limited by tumor heterogeneity, lack of tumor specificity, off-target toxicities, and transient therapeutic action(s). Strategies that provide tumor-specific, sustained concentrations of drugs to the tumors and tumor receptor-specific binding, while reducing off-target effects are needed to ensure sufficient tumor cell uptake within the primary and metastatic tumor microenvironment. The decreased non-specific adhesivity, receptor-targeted nanoparticle formulations (“DART” nanoparticles) of the invention were assessed for clinical potential in directing biological agents to the cell surface receptor Fn14, which is expressed in many solid cancer types, including TNBC primary tumors and metastatic lesions. They are contemplated for use against solid tumors, particularly brain tumors such as glioblastoma and breast cancer, including metastatic breast cancer.

column12: Scale cancer cell membrane-coated nanoparticles as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of nano-drug delivery systems, in particular to squamous carcinoma cell membrane coated nanoparticles as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The squamous carcinoma cell membrane coated nanoparticles comprise an inner core and a shell, the inner core is formed by coating adriamycin with PLGA, and the shell is a squamous carcinoma cell membrane integrated with phospholipid modified indocyanine green. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a squamous carcinoma cell membrane; preparing squamous carcinoma cell vesicles; the preparation method comprises the following steps: modifying a photosensitizer, loading the modified photosensitizer and squamous carcinoma cell membrane vesicles, mixing the treated photosensitizer and nanoparticles, and repeatedly extruding in a liposome extruder to obtain the nanoparticles coated with the squamous carcinoma cell membrane vesicles. According to the technical scheme, the nanoparticle and the preparation method overcome the defects of low solubility, low bioavailability and poor targeting property of adriamycin and indocyanine green, so that the solubility and blood circulation time of chemotherapeutics and photosensitizers are increased, and meanwhile, the nanoparticle can reach a cancer site in a targeting manner to realize precise treatment.

column12: Aripiprazole sustained release preparation for injection and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of medicines, in particular to an aripiprazole sustained release preparation for injection and a preparation method thereof. The sustained release preparation is prepared from microspheres containing aripiprazole raw medicine, a temperature-sensitive hydrogel solution and a freeze-drying protective agent, wherein the weight of the aripiprazole active compound accounts for 5.00-50.00% of the total weight of the microspheres, the concentration of the aripiprazole active compound in the temperature-sensitive hydrogel solution is 1 mg/mL-10 mg/mL, and 0.02-0.2 g of a freeze-drying protective agent is added into each milliliter of the temperature-sensitive hydrogel solution. The aripiprazole sustained-release preparation for injection is a dual sustained-release system, so that the hydrogel with reticular pore channels can play a sustained-release role on free aripiprazole outside microspheres and on the surfaces of the microspheres, and toxic and side effects caused by burst release are prevented; the degradation of the PLGA can be accelerated by retaining acidic substances after the degradation of the PLGA in a skeleton structure, so that the occurrence of a drug release retardation period at the early stage of administration is avoided, the drug is continuously released to reach an effective treatment concentration, and a treatment effect is achieved without oral administration.

column12: Composite bone tissue scaffold for treating femoral head necrosis and preparation method thereof

column12: STABLE SUSTAINED RELEASE THERAPEUTIC COMPOSITIONS IN APROTIC POLAR SOLVENTS AND METHODS OF MANUFACTURING THE SAME.

In certain embodiments, the invention is directed to formulations comprising one or more therapeutic agents, as well as methods of making such formulations, comprising at least one therapeutic agent dissolved in an aprotic polar solvent such as DMSO, comprising at least one ionization stabilizing excipient (suitably, a mineral acid) and at least one sustained release modifier (suitably, a divalent cation-donating compound such as a zinc salt and/or a polymer such as a PLGA) in concentrations sufficient to impart physical and chemical stability to the therapeutic agent and to produce a formulation that results in a sustained release of the therapeutic agent into the bloodstream of an animal to which the formulation has been administered. The invention also relates to methods of producing such storage stable sustained release therapeutic formulations and to methods of treating, preventing and diagnosing certain physical conditions and disorders, notably hypoglycemia, by administering such storage stable sustained release therapeutic formulations to a patient.

column12: PLGA (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid))-based local ophthalmic sustained-release compound preparation as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides a local ophthalmic sustained-release compound preparation based on PLGA (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid)) and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of drug combination delivery. The preparation method comprises the following steps: heating and stirring a high polymer spinning solution based on PLGA, and then carrying out electrostatic spinning and fiber surface modification to obtain the biological functional PLGA micro sleeve, mixing and incubating the PLGA micro sleeve and a medicine, assembling by adsorption, and drying by nitrogen flow to obtain the local ophthalmic sustained-release compound preparation based on the PLGA. Wherein the drug can be a drug-loaded PLGA nano particle or a free drug combination. The compound preparation prepared by the method has the advantages of efficient encapsulation of the combined drug, good biological safety, time-programmed drug release, personalized customization of morphology and size and the like, and has important application potentials in the aspects of maintaining intraocular effective drug concentration, reducing administration frequency, improving the curative effect of the combined drug and the like.

column12: Stem cell biomimetic microparticles
column13: Provided are stem cell biomimetic microparticles comprised of at least one stem cell-derived paracrine polypeptide or growth factor embedded in a polymer core particle that further comprises an outer layer of at least one fragment of a cell membrane of a stem cell disposed on the core particle. The polymer core may be constituted of any biocompatible and biodegradable polymer or copolymer, or a combination thereof that allows the embedding of the paracrine factors and their prolonged release from the core. The core and hence the microparticles can be biodegradable, allowing eventual elimination from the recipient animal or human subject. The core particles are sized to allow both transport through blood vessels and extravasation from the blood vessels into the surrounding tissues. The core particle may further include at least one polypeptide or peptide growth factor to induce the generation and proliferation of a population of stem cells.

column12: DOSAGE FORM FOR INTRA-ARTICULAR INJECTION COMPRISING COLCHICINE FOR USE IN THE TREATMENT OF CRYSTAL-AND NON-CRYSTAL ASSOCIATED ACUTE INFLAMMATORY ARTHRITIS
column13: The present invention relates to a pharmaceutical composition under the form of a suspension comprising controlled release microparticles comprising colchicine, suitable for intra-articular injection into a joint, for use in the treatment of crystal-associated and non-crystal associated acute inflammatory arthritis, in particular a crystal-associated arthropathy attacks or flares or acute forms of tendinitis and capsulitis, wherein the microparticles have a mean particle size greater than 10 µm, wherein the time required to release 80% by weight of the colchicine in the microparticles lies between 1 day and 15 days, wherein the colchicine is present in a concentration ranging from 0.05 to 5 mg per ml of suspension and wherein the pharmaceutical composition has a volume ranging from 0.1 ml to 5 ml.It also relates to a formulation under the form of a powder comprising controlled release microparticles comprising colchicine and a polymeric matrix, wherein the percentage weight ratio between the colchicine and the total weight of the microparticles ranges 1 to 35% by weight.It further relates to a pharmaceutical composition under the form of a sterile and injectable suspension suitable for an intra-articular injection, obtained by mixing a formulation under the form of a powder according to the invention, with an aqueous injection vehicle.

column12: Medicine for combined immunization, temperature-sensitive gel composition, chemotactic factor particles and application of chemotactic factor particles
column13: The invention discloses a medicine for combined immunization, a temperature-sensitive gel composition, chemotactic factor particles and application thereof, a mixed solution of an injectable temperature-sensitive polymer PLGA-PEG-PLGA, the chemotactic factor particles and an immune checkpoint inhibitor PD-1 monoclonal antibody is used, temperature-sensitive hydrogel is formed beside a solid tumor at the body temperature, a chemotactic factor and aPD1 are controllably released for a long time, and the combined immunization is achieved. The targeting of adoptive T cells to solid tumors and the resistance to immunosuppression in a tumor microenvironment are enhanced. The immunoregulation temperature-sensitive gel and the tumor penetrating peptide iRGD are combined to enhance infiltration of adoptive T cells to solid tumors, so that the solid tumors are efficiently treated. The chemotactic factor particles are prepared from a chemotactic factor modified by distearoyl phosphoethanolamine-polyethylene glycol-N-hydroxysuccinimide and an albumin carrier.

column12: MICROSPHERE FOR STABLY RELEASING FULVESTRANT, AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR
column13: A sustained-release pharmaceutical composition of fulvestrant, which comprises the following components: fulvestrant or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof or a solvate thereof, a polymer A and a polymer B, wherein the polymer A is a poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid) (PLGA) and the polymer B is polylactic acid (PLA). The sustained-release pharmaceutical composition exists in the form of a microsphere and can be prepared by a phase emulsion-solvent evaporation method. The sustained-release microsphere can overcome the sudden release phenomenon and delayed release problem during drug release, has the advantages of high drug loading capacity, high encapsulation efficiency, long-term release, etc., and can be used for treating breast cancer.

column12: Microsphere capable of stably releasing fulvestrant and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to a sustained-release pharmaceutical composition capable of stably releasing fulvestrant and a preparation method of the sustained-release pharmaceutical composition. Specifically, the invention relates to a sustained-release pharmaceutical composition, which comprises the following components: an active ingredient fulvestrant or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof or solvates thereof, a polymer A and a polymer B, wherein the polymer A is a polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer (PLGA); and the polymer B is polylactic acid (PLA). The sustained-release pharmaceutical composition exists in the form of microspheres and can be prepared by a phase emulsification-solvent evaporation method. The sustained-release microsphere can overcome the problems of burst release and delayed release of the drug in the drug release process, so that the drug is released stably and controllably in vivo. The sustained-release microsphere has the advantages of high drug loading capacity, high encapsulation efficiency, long-acting release (more than 60 days) and the like, and can be used for treating breast cancer.

column12: FORMULATIONS OF ACTIVE PHARMACEUTICAL INGREDIENTS (APIS) FOR LOCAL DELIVERY VIA ACTIVE MICROBOT
column13: Provided herein are pharmaceutical formulations, methods of manufacturing thereof, and methods of treatment. The pharmaceutical formulations are adapted to serve as a payload on or in a microbot, and comprise a tablet of a therapeutically effective dose of a pharmaceutical agent and have dimensions such that the tablet may fit on or in the microbot. The pharmaceutical formulation may be formed into, e.g., a cylinder or spheroid of 1mm dimension, and the pharmaceutical agent may be a small molecule drug, a peptide, a peptoid, a biologic drug, cells, or any combination thereof. Thus, the pharmaceutical formulation of the present description offers delivery of targeted therapy at a locus in a subject, e.g., a tumor.

column12: THERAPEUTIC MRNA VACCINE FOR MALIGNANCIES
column13: Described herein is a method for cancer immunotherapy by administering to a subject an mRNA vaccine designed to express the carbonyl terminal segment of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG). Also described an improved adjuvant by co-administration of an antisense IL-10 molecule to shift the vaccine immune response to enhanced T-cell responses to hCG. Other embodiments relate to devices and methods for improved delivery of the mRNA vaccine and adjuvant. The intended use involves repeated administration of the vaccine components to subjects over an interval of several months in a repeated boosting strategy.

column12: PHARMACEUTICAL COMPOSITION COMPRISING SUSTAINED-RELEASE MICROSPHERES INCLUDING GLP-1 ANALOGUE OR PHARMACEUTICALLY ACCEPTABLE SALT THEREOF
column13: The present invention relates to a pharmaceutical composition useful for prevention or treatment of diabetes, beta-cell function preservation, high blood pressure, hyperlipidemia, obesity, non-alcoholic steatohepatitis or neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease, as it comprises a sustained-release microsphere comprising semaglutide, a pharmaceutically acceptable salt, hydrate or solvate thereof, and thereby, it can effectively inhibit fatal side-effects by preventing initial burst of a drug and comprise a high content of drug compared to a particle size, and therefore, it can minimize the patient's pain and inflammatory reaction that may occur during administration.

column12: Delivery of hydrophobic active agent particles
column13: Embodiments of the invention include drug delivery coatings and devices including the same. In an embodiment, the invention includes a drug delivery coating including a polymeric layer. The polymeric layer can include a hydrophilic outer surface. The coating can also include a matrix contacting the hydrophilic outer surface. The matrix can include a particulate hydrophobic therapeutic agent and a cationic agent. The polymeric layer can further include a hydrophilic polymer having pendent photoreactive groups and a photo-crosslinker including two aryl ketone functionalities. Other embodiments are also included herein.

column12: Tetrodotoxin sustained release microsphere as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a tetrodotoxin sustained release microsphere, which is prepared from tetrodotoxin (TTX), polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer (PLGA), formic acid and polyvinyl alcohol (PVA). column12: COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS FOR THE TREATMENT AND PROPHYLAXIS OF SURGICAL SITE INFECTIONS
column13: The present invention provides methods for preventing, inhibiting or treating a surgical site infection associated with a surgical operation comprising the step of applying to the surgical site a biocompatible, biodegradable substrate being impregnated and/or having its surface coated fully or partially with a matrix composition which provides local controlled and prolonged release of at least one pharmaceutically active agent at the surgical site.

column12: FILTERS CONTAINING TERPENE-LOADED NANOFIBRES FOR ENHANCED BACTERICIDAL, FUNGICIDAL AND VIRUCIDAL ACTIVITY, PREPARATION METHODS AND APPLICATIONS THEREOF
column13: Described herein are air/gas filter media containing terpene-loaded nanofibres for enhanced bactericidal, fungicidal and viricidal activity, preparation methods and applications thereof. More specifically, air/gas filter media for deactivating microorganisms and/or viruses. The air/gas filter media comprising one or more textile materials comprising one or more bactericidal and/or viricidal electrospun nanofibre layers. The pores within the nanofibre layers are dimensioned to prevent passage of airborne particles and upon contact with the nanofibre air filter, the bactericidal, fungicidal and/or viricidal actives deactivate the microorganisms and/or viruses within the airborne particles. Furthermore, the air filters have efficient breathability, washability performance and depending on the polymers used, may be environmentally friendly by being biodegradable and compostable.

column12: ENGINEERED BMP2 SURROGATE PROTEINS
column13: A BMP2 surrogate protein is provided comprising two different antigen binding regions (ABR), which can be configured as immunoglobulin "single variable domains" (ISV). A first ISV specifically binds to a first BMP2 receptor, e.g. BMPR1a; and a second ISV specifically binds to a second BMP2 receptor, e.g. BMPR2. In some embodiments the first and second ISV are joined by a cleavable linker that is susceptible to proteases selectively expressed in monocytic cells or macrophages, relative to skeletal stem cells.

column12: Injectable hydrogel system with immune microenvironment regulation and control function
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and relates to a hydrogel system with a temperature-sensitive injectable function and an immune microenvironment regulation function. According to the invention, the double-component PEG-PLGA-PEG injectable hydrogel is used as a drug carrier, and the plerixafor-zinc chelate is selected and synthesized to realize slow release of the micromolecular hydrophilic drug plerixafor; the nanoparticles prepared based on an electrostatic adsorption technology are selected to realize slow release of biomacromolecule CpG oligodeoxynucleotide in the hydrogel and increase of antigen presentation efficiency. The co-delivery system has the function of sol-gel transition at the body temperature (higher than 30 DEG C), and can be used for in-situ direct filling of a clinical postoperative resection cavity. And co-loading and slow release of the loaded micromolecular drug plerixafor and the macromolecular drug are realized, the tumor postoperative immune microenvironment is cooperatively regulated and controlled, the killing effect of an immune system on residual tumor cells is enhanced, and postoperative recurrence of glioblastoma is inhibited.
